camel_example: aliyun vpc ListEnhanhcedNatGatewayAvailableZones --region cn-hangzhou --Filter.1.Value true --AcceptLanguage 'zh-CN' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Key PrivateLinkEnabled --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the zones where NAT gateway resources are available by calling the ListEnhanhcedNatGatewayAvailableZones operation
description_zh: 调用ListEnhanhcedNatGatewayAvailableZones接口查询NAT网关的资源可用区
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-enhanhced-nat-gateway-available-zones --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accept-language zh-CN --filter Value=true Key=PrivateLinkEnabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEnhanhcedNatGatewayAvailableZones

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID.
This example queries the zones available for NAT gateway resources in the UAE (Dubai) region
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
本示例查询阿联酋（迪拜）地域NAT网关资源的可用区
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN (default): Chinese.
en-US: English

返回结果显示的语言。取值：

zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

fields.help_en: The filter condition. Currently, only PrivateLinkEnabled is supported
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件。目前仅支持对PrivateLinkEnabled进行过滤
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The filter value that corresponds to the filter condition.

If the filter condition is PrivateLinkEnabled, you must specify a filter value. Valid values: true and false

过滤条件对应的过滤值。

当过滤条件为PrivateLinkEnabled时，需要配置过滤值。 取值为true或false
fields.name: value

parameters.help_zh: 过滤信息，支持传入键值对查询结果进行过滤
